phase.sample: Check, copy and hash single file
phase.report: Check results and create completion report
explorer.available: Shows the selected result folder in its parent Windows Explorer directory, without downloading.
explorer.open: Windows Explorer shows the parent directory with the result folder selected. Also check an already open Explorer window.
viewer.available: Tested file invocation for version 2026.5.0. Starts only on your click, outside the internal preview; no sandbox.
viewer.open: Viewer start requested on the server. Check the viewer window.
workspace.note: Applies only to new jobs. Existing data is not moved. Server-local setting, excluded from configuration exports.
cleanup.root_job: Registered app data directories (this job only)
preview.files: At most 200 files from the saved result list.
preview.csv: Filtering and sorting apply before pagination to the bounded file excerpt. Numbers: decimal point, no thousands separators. Time: ISO 8601; values with and without time zones are grouped separately, without inventing a time zone. Empty/invalid values remain at the end.
preview.xlsx: Stored formula values only; no calculation. Search/sorting apply only to the bounded sheet excerpt. Numbers use a decimal point. Time: ISO 8601; values with and without time zones are grouped separately, without inventing a time zone. Empty/invalid values remain at the end; Excel date serials stay raw.
cleanup.note.cache: Permanently delete. History, settings and locally referenced originals are retained. Result folders are retained; extracted inputs, working files and complete command logs are removed.
cleanup.note.evidence: Permanently delete. History, settings and locally referenced originals are retained. Only uploaded input copies are removed.
cleanup.note.results: Permanently delete. History, settings and locally referenced originals are retained. Result folders, result ZIPs AND completion reports are removed; Explorer/download are no longer available for them.
recommendation.0: Check details and the last tool output in Logs.
recommendation.1: Restart the app and confirm Windows UAC. Service status must show administrator; also check file/folder permissions.
recommendation.2: Check drive folders in the ZIP and --msource in the mode. For multiple drives, explicitly select the desired folder.
recommendation.3: For a known backup of your own, enable 'Allow high compression' and start a new run.
recommendation.4: Free space on the data directory drive. Extracted data and the result ZIP require additional space.
recommendation.5: For large ZIPs use 'Local file on server' as source to avoid browser upload.
recommendation.6: Check ZIP completeness; split or damaged archives are not processed.
